<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917207_theRebbe_479" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917207_theRebbe_479__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through Torah study in the manner of "that you shall place before them," including the acquisition of a servant, one merits the revelation of Moshiach's new Torah in the true and complete redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And through the study of Torah in the manner of "that you shall place before them,"</t>
    <t s="1">"when you acquire a Hebrew servant,"</t>
    <t s="2">that the study is with understanding and reasoning, and together with this, with the self-nullification of a servant</t>
    <t s="3">[so that the study of the revealed Torah will be in this manner, it is through the study of the inner dimension of Torah,</t>
    <t s="4">"tashim" (you shall place) — a term for "simah" (a treasure),</t>
    <t s="5">a storehouse],</t>
    <t s="6">through this they will merit the revelation of the Torah of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="7">"a new Torah shall go forth from Me,"</t>
    <t s="8">in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="9">speedily in our days, literally.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
